_purpose: The ONE pin of the frqtl SDK this site vendors. site/vendor/frqtl-sdk/<version>/dist is the published npm tarball's dist/ copied unchanged. The package's own dist/dist-manifest.json lists every other dist file with its sha256; this pin records the TARBALL it came from and the manifest's own sha256 (taken from the packed tarball, never from the copy), so the copy cannot vouch for itself. scripts/test/sdk-copy.test.mjs serves the site and hashes every served file against the manifest (COMPOSE_AND_CAPTURE.md, 'Checking your copy'). Re-vendor = npm pack the pinned version into an empty scratch dir, copy dist/, re-record the tarball and manifest hashes here.
name: @descix/frqtl-sdk
